supersession: Old Bugeon whole-ABC Fig2 rows are historical sensitivity controls, not the current anatomy-matched reference authority.
AtlasFlow outputs lacking atlas/measured+atlas blocks are superseded by the v2/current workflow.
Any paired-delta table containing only R2/Spearman is superseded by the nine-metric paired contract.
Zhao AtlasLift should not be summarized by giant delta-R2 values alone; use full multi-metric/held-unit evidence.
Fig3 broad sweep does not establish universal FDR-supported superiority; primary M1 and true-hidden Wang evidence carry distinct contracts.
Manuscript-side Fig3 sweep is no longer the only executable route; public fixed_budget is authoritative for new-dataset integration testing.

Allen pre-dedup 1369-row integration output is superseded by the strict 1321 unique-HCR-cell run. Outcome-blind max-IoU dedup leaves all key Fig1-3 effects intact; see ALLEN_VL_HCR_DEDUP_SENSITIVITY_20261003.csv.
Pre-integrity target selection that used only global non-missingness is superseded by fold-aware target support; held-out outcomes are never imputed for scoring.
cell_id is session-scoped by default; only declared stable IDs such as hcr_id/matched_cell_id/unique_roicat_id are audited across sessions.
Categorical one-hot molecular panels must block continuous quartile effect-size inference rather than report an empty successful result.

MICrONS full-cohort connectivity analyses that median-impute the 95.34% unmeasured connectivity block are superseded by the integrity-safe full-cohort + 1151-cell connectivity-complete dual-cohort contract.
For single-animal MICrONS, session/acquisition-held evaluation must never be described as held-animal or cross-animal replication.
Stable MICrONS EM identity is root_id; root_id is now part of the stable-ID duplicate audit.

MICrONS connectivity-complete neurons are a non-random EM-resolved subpopulation: matched per-session random controls show lower space/type+space predictive geometry in the complete-case cohort. Connectivity effects must therefore be scoped to that subpopulation, not generalized to all V1 cells.
